name: io.github.berba-q/faostat-mcp
title: FAOSTAT MCP
description: FAOSTAT data for 245 countries: crops, trade, food security, and emissions via 23 MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: FAOSTAT_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A FAOSTAT access token from the Developer Portal. Tokens expire after 1 hour, so prefer FAOSTAT_USERNAME + FAOSTAT_PASSWORD, which refresh automatically.

environmentVariables.name: FAOSTAT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: FAOSTAT account email (free account at https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#developer-portal). Used to obtain and refresh tokens automatically.

environmentVariables.name: FAOSTAT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: FAOSTAT account password. Used with FAOSTAT_USERNAME to obtain and refresh tokens automatically.
